privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: AIWardrobe ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application.

informationWeCollect.title: 1. Information we collect
informationWeCollect.body:
We collect only the information needed to provide core features.

• Account information: email, username, and authentication identifiers when you sign up or sign in.
• Wardrobe content you provide: photos/videos you choose to upload or capture, and item metadata you add or edit (e.g., category, color, brand, notes).
• AI feature inputs: images and text you submit for wardrobe scan, outfit generation, or virtual try-on.
• Approximate location (optional): when you grant location permission, we use your current location to fetch local weather for outfit suggestions.
• Purchase/subscription data: subscription status and purchase events (processed by Apple and our subscription provider).
• Diagnostics (optional): crash logs and performance data to improve reliability.

howWeUse.title: 2. How we use information
howWeUse.body:
We use your information to:

• Provide wardrobe scanning, outfit recommendations, and virtual try-on.
• Sync your wardrobe across devices when you are signed in.
• Personalize suggestions based on the items you add and the context you provide (like weather).
• Provide customer support and respond to requests.
• Prevent abuse and secure our service.
• Improve app performance, stability, and feature quality.

If you enable analytics sharing, we also use anonymized usage events to understand which features work well and to fix issues.

dataStorage.title: 3. Data storage and retention
dataStorage.body:
Your account and wardrobe data may be stored in our cloud database and storage.

We keep data only as long as needed to provide the service or as required by law. You can request deletion by deleting your account in the app. After account deletion, we delete associated wardrobe items and uploaded media, subject to limited legal/operational retention (e.g., fraud prevention, backups for a short period).

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party services and AI processing
thirdParty.body:
To deliver AI features, we may process your inputs (such as selected photos) through our servers and trusted third-party providers.

Depending on the feature, this can include:
• Cloud infrastructure and database (for authentication, storage, and syncing).
• AI providers (for image understanding, background removal, generation, and try-on rendering).
• Weather providers (when you enable location-based weather).
• Crash/diagnostic providers (if enabled).
• Affiliate / shopping links: when you tap a product link, we may record an event such as "product clicked" for analytics and attribution.

We do not sell your personal information. We only share data with service providers to operate and improve the app, and we require them to protect your data.

yourRights.title: 5. Your choices and rights
yourRights.body:
You can:

• Use many features without sharing optional permissions.
• Control permissions in iOS Settings (Camera, Photos, Location, Microphone).
• Turn analytics sharing on/off in the app settings.
• Access and update your profile details in the app.
• Delete your account in the app to request deletion of your data.

If you need help with access or deletion requests, contact us using the details below.

childrensPrivacy.title: 6. Children’s privacy
childrensPrivacy.body: AIWardrobe is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us so we can take appropriate action.

changes.title: 7. Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will update the “Last updated” date and may provide additional notice in the app when changes are significant.

contact.title: 8. Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about privacy or data deletion, contact us at: support@aiwardrobe.club
